analysis.b1: model + environment + model×environment + source family + public scalar difficulty
analysis.bootstrap: 1000 task-cluster bootstrap of strong-profile minus CDE OOF loss is descriptive at pilot stage; no CI pass threshold is imposed before independent confirmation
analysis.cde: strong profile baseline + all five demand×environment terms for spec and both vs NL; no outcome-driven feature selection
analysis.competence: both candidate models must have overall semantic success between 10% and 90%
analysis.confirm_gate: both models nonfloor/nonceiling AND abs selected DiD >=0.10 AND CDE leave-one-task-out LL < strong profile baseline LL
analysis.secondary_direction: among spec-vs-NL and both-vs-NL choose the contrast with largest absolute model difference-in-differences; require absolute DiD >=0.10; freeze its sign for confirmation
analysis.strong_profile_baseline: B1 + all five frozen outcome-blind demand proxies + model×demand terms

candidate_selection: the only two local models passing the pre-frozen competence screen; GPT-OSS excluded because 18/18 ceiling
outcome: one-shot hidden semantic correctness across all packaged positive testcases; compile or any wrong case is failure
tasks: all 24 tasks in the frozen R4b pilot split
